title: VAT
creditIn: VAT credit from the previous period
late: Deadline passed {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago
zero: No transaction in the period: the declaration is still required (nil return).
ledgerDeductible: Deductible VAT recorded in the period (invoices received)
ledgerNote: Purchase VAT is recorded when the invoice is received and becomes deductible when it is paid.
itemsWithoutVat: {count, plural, one {# product sold without a VAT category} other {# products sold without a VAT category}}
invoicesWithoutIce: {count, plural, one {# supplier invoice without our ICE} other {# supplier invoices without our ICE}}
cashOverLimits: {count, plural, one {# cash payment above the limits} other {# cash payments above the limits}}
unpaid: {count, plural, one {# unpaid supplier invoice: VAT not yet deductible} other {# unpaid supplier invoices: VAT not yet deductible}}
